title: ABRIDGED BID NOTICE UNDER OPEN DOMESTIC BIDDING - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# ABRIDGED BID NOTICE UNDER OPEN DOMESTIC BIDDING
Uganda Revenue Authority invites sealed bids from eligible bidders for:
Procurement Reference Number
Subject of the Procurement
Bid Security (UGX)
Pre-bid Meeting
Date of Bid Closing
URA/CGO/NCON/25-26/01973
Provision of Hotel and Hospitality Services Under Framework Contract.
11 th March 2026 at 10:00am on 13 th Floor URA Tower Procurement Office.
Friday 27 th March 2026 at 10:00am on 13 th Floor URA Tower Procurement Office.
URA/CSD/CONS/25-26/01754
Provision of Insurance Brokerage Services.
13 th March 2026 at 10:00am on 13 th Floor URA Tower Procurement Office.
The Bidding documents shall be inspected, issued and the bids shall be delivered at;
Procurement & Disposal Division,
Uganda Revenue Authority Headquarters,
13 th Floor URA Tower,
P. O. Box 7279, Kampala.
Telephone: 256 (0) 417 – 442155/6/7/8/9
The Bidding documents in English may be collected by interested bidders upon submission of a written application letter to the Assistant Commissioner Procurement & Disposal Division at the address in (2) above.
Bidders are advised to generate Bank Payment Registration Slips from the URA website www.ura.go.ug and make payment of a non-refundable fee of U GX 100,000 for each procurement to any bank authorized to receive Non-Tax Revenue fees on behalf of URA.
The detailed bid notice is available at the Entity’s website at www.ura.go.ug and at www.ppda.go.ug
The procurements by Uganda Revenue Authority (URA) are regulated by the Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets Authority.
ACCOUNTING OFFICER
